claims.claim_text: Archer has a purchase agreement with United Airlines for the conditional purchase of up to $1.0 billion of aircraft, with an option for another $500.0 million; United paid $10.0 million in pre-delivery payments for 100 aircraft in August 2022.
claims.subject: Archer Aviation
claims.source_quote: We have entered into a purchase agreement with United Airlines Inc. ('United') for the conditional purchase of up to $1.0 billion worth of aircraft, with an option for another $500.0 million worth of aircraft... in August 2022, United paid us $10.0 million in pre-delivery payments for 100 aircraft covered under our purchase agreement.

claims.claim_text: Stellantis is Archer's strategic manufacturing partner; in January 2023 they entered a manufacturing collaboration and strategic funding agreement, with Stellantis to act as contract manufacturer at Covington; Archer drew $95.0M of $150M strategic funding in 2023.
claims.subject: Archer Aviation
claims.source_quote: In January 2023, we announced a significant expansion of our partnership by entering into a manufacturing collaboration arrangement and strategic funding agreement. As a result, Stellantis is working with us to stand up our manufacturing facility in Covington... The goal over the long term is for Stellantis to mass produce our eVTOL aircraft as our contract manufacturer.

claims.claim_text: In August 2023, Archer entered into two new contracts with the U.S. Air Force worth up to $142.0 million, including aircraft purchases.
claims.subject: Archer Aviation
claims.source_quote: In August 2023, we entered into two new contracts with the U.S. Air Force worth up to $142.0 million, which includes the purchase of aircraft, as well as the sharing of additional flight test data and certification related test reports, pilot training, and the development of maintenance and repair operations.

claims.claim_text: Archer is building a 350,000 sq ft high-volume manufacturing facility in Covington, Newton County, Georgia, designed for up to 650 aircraft per year, expandable to 900,000 sq ft for 2,000 aircraft per year.
claims.subject: Archer Aviation
claims.source_quote: we completed the build out of a production facility in San Jose, California, which we will utilize to produce the initial Midnight aircraft used as part of our FAA certification program, as well as a high-volume production facility in Covington, Georgia. We have begun our Covington facility build-out and target substantial completion of the first phase in 2024, which is a 350,000 square-foot facility that is designed to be capable of supporting production of up to 650 aircraft per year.

claims.claim_text: Archer has filed patent applications in the United States and foreign countries; issued patents are claimed to expire between 2040 and 2044, implying a granted patent portfolio centered on eVTOL aircraft, electric propulsion, and flight control technologies.
claims.subject: Archer Aviation
claims.object_value: patent portfolio in eVTOL / propulsion / flight control
claims.source_quote: We have also filed patent applications in the United States and foreign countries covering certain of our technology. In general, our issued patents expire between 2040 and 2044.

claims.claim_text: Archer operates a production facility in San Jose, California (used to produce initial Midnight aircraft for FAA certification) plus offices, R&D, and flight-test facilities in Santa Clara, Mountain View, and Salinas, California.
claims.subject: Archer Aviation
claims.object_value: San Jose / Santa Clara / Mountain View / Salinas, CA
claims.source_quote: we completed the build out of a production facility in San Jose, California... We currently lease our headquarters in San Jose, California. We lease additional offices, research and development facilities, and manufacturing facilities in Santa Clara and Mountain View, California and flight test facilities at Salinas Municipal Airport in Salinas, California.
